description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and platform-specific synchronization mechanisms, serving as a core synchronization utility header for the project.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion via platform-specific mutex mechanisms, supporting lock and unlock operations.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore with binary (0 or 1) states, supporting lock, unlock, and status check operations.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that maintains a count, supporting lock, unlock, and try-unlock operations.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A synchronization event object supporting wait, set, reset, and status check operations.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.

methods.name: CriticalSection
methods.description: Constructor for CriticalSection, initializes platform-specific mutex.

methods.name: CriticalSection::~CriticalSection
methods.description: Destructor for CriticalSection, cleans up mutex resources.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Lock
methods.description: Locks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Acquires the semaphore, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.
